text: Finance, Marketing, and the warehouse team have each been reporting a different Active Customer count for years -- and none of them were technically wrong. Each one answered a different question.
Finance counts open accounts-receivable activity. Marketing counts CRM engagement. The warehouse runs an old, undocumented blended flag. Three real numbers, zero agreement.

The real fix wasn't picking a winner -- it was realizing Finance and Marketing were never measuring the same thing. Finance's billing-basis number becomes the one Approved Active Customer term. Marketing's gets its own name: Engaged Account.
Each term links to exactly one real source column -- Active Customer to Oracle, Engaged Account to Salesforce. The warehouse's old blended flag gets marked deprecated.
The conflict that drove three different numbers into the same meeting is resolved. Next: naming exactly who owns each domain going forward.
